changelog:
v2.10.0 - Peek Guard + Silent Recording

- NEW Peek Guard: someone looks over your shoulder -> screen goes BLACK instantly (front camera counts faces). Auto-clears when they leave.
- NEW Dim Shield: dark tint mode - readable straight-on, hard to read from an angle.
- NEW Silent Recording mode in Screen Recorder: no REC panel, no toasts - invisible recording.
- Screen Recorder UI now shows the REC panel the moment recording starts (v2.9.9 fix).
